run_model_inference: run a two-tower detector model inference on an image using mmdet build_detector and simple_test
build_detector_from_config: build a detector model from an MMCV config file using mmdet models build_detector
normalize_image: normalize an input image using mmcv imnormalize with mean and std values
load_mmcv_config: load an MMCV config from a Python file using Config.fromfile to get model settings
test_detector_model: test a two-tower detector model by running simple_test on a preprocessed image tensor
